messages:
Marie: Quick heads-up — Boreal interview confirmed for Tue 3/26 11:00am PT. Need quote sign-off + final transcript redlines by EOD Mon. Can we lock owners?
Sam: Got it. Who's owning quote approval with the customer?
Lina: I drafted 2 quote options from the raw audio. Pasting the short one here: ```\n"Redwood reduced our tail latency by 3x while cutting token cost per request in half."\n```
Sam: That one is strong. I'll run it by the customer. @Tomas can you take transcript redlines?
Tomas: Yep — I can do redlines. Will review and upload comments by 4pm today.
Marie: Awesome, thanks. Promo plan — blog + short launch post + 30-min customer webinar. Need final approved quote for blog and slide pull quotes.
Lina: Also pulled a 15s soundbite we can use for socials. Customer wants to remove the phrase about "roadmap" though.
Sam: Customer note received: they prefer the focus on performance and privacy, not roadmap. Sam: @legalbot any concerns about the phrasing?
legalbot: Auto-check: please ensure the transcript is stored in the secure customer folder and that quotes are signed off in writing per the NDA appendix. Upload link: https://drive.redwood.example/boreal/interview-raw (secure).
Marie: Ok — action items: Tomas = transcript redlines (4pm), Sam = customer quote sign-off (EOD), Lina = draft blog using approved quote (Mon morning). I'll own webinar logistics.
Tomas: Quick question — are we allowed to publish the interview excerpt as audio? Customer said maybe, but needs legal OK.
legalbot: Flag: audio publication requires explicit audio release. Please get signed consent.
Sam: I'll request audio consent in my reply.
Lina: Draft headline options (working): "How Boreal scaled real-time search with Redwood Inference" or "Cutting latency and cost: Boreal's story with Redwood" — will refine once quote locked.
Marie: Love the second one — more benefit-led.
Sam: Customer approved Lina's quote option but asked we swap "token cost" -> "per-request cost". They also asked to shorten to one sentence.
Lina: New suggested quote: ```\n"Redwood cut our per-request cost in half and slashed tail latency by 3x."\n```
Marie: Nice. Legal asked to replace "slashed" with "reduced". Small language tweak required.
Lina: Revised quote: ```\n"Redwood reduced our per-request cost by 50% and reduced tail latency by 3x."\n```
Tomas: I'll include the redline on the transcript and highlight the approved quote.
Marie: Perfect — once Sam confirms audio release and uploads signed quote, Lina will finalize blog draft and slide pulls.
Sam: Sent consent request to the customer — cc'd legal. Will update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:
Marie: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as single source of truth. If anything slips, ping me directly. :sparkles:
